column1: 20652§mitigate§ˈmɪtɪɡeɪt§The government introduced new measures to mitigate tensions between local residents and property developers.§政府出台了新措施，以**缓和**当地居民与房地产开发商之间的紧张关系。§补例句
20653§ignorance§ˈɪgnərəns§Not ignorance, but the ignorance of ignorance, is the death of knowledge.§知识的死亡不是**无知**本身，而是对无知的无知。§
20654§aesthetic§iːsˈθetɪk§What are utilitarian objects to a Westerner may be prized aesthetic objects in other cultures.§被西方人视为功利性的东西，在其他文化中可能会因其**美学**价值而备受推崇。§
20655§screen§skriːn§Everything on the screen interests those children.§那些孩子觉得**屏幕**上的一切都很有趣。§
20656§absent§ˈæbsənt§Why were you absent from my birthday party yesterday?§你昨天怎么**没来**参加我的生日派对呢？§
20657§scrape§skreɪp§He scraped the mud off his shoes with the knife.§他用小刀**刮去**鞋上的泥土。§
20658§promotion§prəˈməʊʃn§Would you be willing to attend any of the special promotions for the new channel?§你愿意参加新频道的任何特别**宣传**活动吗？§
20659§recreation§ˌriːkriˈeɪʃn§As you can see, the building you are in now contains this main lounge, the dining room and the recreation room.§如你所见，你现在所在的这幢大楼包括主休息室、餐厅和**娱乐**室。§
20660§specialise§ˈspeʃəlaɪz§Two years later, we will specialise and take courses in one or two subjects.§两年后，我们将**专攻**一两门学科并学习这些学科的课程。§
20661§magnificent§mægˈnɪfɪsnt§The garage around the corner contains the magnificent old Rolls-Royce which used to belong to George.§街角的车库里停着一辆**华丽的**老式劳斯莱斯，它曾经是乔治的。§
20662§spasmodic§spæzˈmɒdɪk§Since the arrival of Europeans, the region experienced a period of spasmodic activity, between 1831 and 1857.§自从欧洲人来到这个地区，在1831到1857年间，它经历了一个**间歇性的**活跃时期。§
20663§fund§fʌnd§They provide funds for zoos in underdeveloped countries.§他们为不发达国家的动物园提供**资金**。§
20664§perceive§pəˈsiːv§While I was examining the small stars, I perceived one that appeared visibly larger than the rest.§我观察那些小星星时，**发现**有一颗明显比其他的大。§
20665§manufacturer§ˌmænjuˈfæktʃərə(r)§Manufacturers must sell these cleaner cars.§**制造商**必须卖掉这些更清洁的汽车。§改译文：cleaner cars 指污染更少的汽车，原译“清洁车”有误，改为“更清洁的汽车”
20666§specification§ˌspesɪfɪˈkeɪʃn§The house has been built exactly to our specifications.§房子完全是按照我们的**工程设计书**建造的。§
20667§schedule§ˈʃedjuːl§The lectures are scheduled for Tuesday and Thursday.§讲座**安排**在星期二和星期四。§
20668§arrangement§əˈreɪndʒmənt§Larger firms appear to be more willing to experiment with flexible working arrangements.§较大型的企业似乎更愿意尝试弹性工作**制**。§
20669§destruction§dɪˈstrʌkʃn§The importation of cheap goods has often contributed to the destruction of local skills and indigenous markets.§进口廉价商品常常会给当地的手工业和本土市场带来**毁灭性**的打击。§

20670§extinguisher§ɪkˈstɪŋgwɪʃə(r)§If you discover a fire, shout "FIRE" and activate the nearest fire alarm. Attack the fire with an extinguisher but do not take any risks.§如果发现火情，应大喊“着火了”，并按响离你最近的火警铃。使用**灭火器**去灭火，但不要冒险。§改例句：英文句中的中文引号改为英文引号
20671§assume§əˈsjuːm§Ecologists have assumed that tropical ecosystems were shaped entirely by natural forces.§生态学家**设想**热带生态系统完全是由自然的力量形成的。§
20672§proportion§prəˈpɔːʃn§The proportion of the population still speaking this language is small.§还在说这种语言的人口**比例**很小。§改译文：原译「少数」没译出 proportion，改为「人口比例很小」
20673§forth§fɔːθ§From this day forth I will study much harder.§从今**以后**我将更加努力学习。§
20674§referee§ˌrefəˈriː§Instead of spending much time refereeing between the two students, I went to the library.§我没有花太多时间**调停**这两名学生，而是去了图书馆。§
20675§forgo§fɔːˈgəʊ§Jack has to forgo his vacation so as to take a summer English course.§杰克为了参加暑期英语班只好**放弃**他的假期。§
20676§assistantship§əˈsɪstənˌʃɪp§The organization has contributed a lot to the social welfare activities such as assistantship programs.§该组织为社会福利做了很多贡献，比如**助教奖学金**项目。§
20677§conversation§ˌkɒnvəˈseɪʃn§The conversation between the new students touched on many new subjects.§新同学之间的**对话**涉及很多新话题。§
20678§recommendation§ˌrekəmenˈdeɪʃn§The skills of making presentations are on the recommendation of a professor.§这些做报告的技巧是一位教授**推荐**的。§改例句：presentation 为可数名词，改为复数 presentations
20679§offset§ˈɒfset§Prices have risen in order to offset the increased cost of materials.§为**弥补**原料成本的增加而提高了价格。§
20680§siesta§siˈestə§These workers have no time for a siesta in summer.§这些工人在夏天都没有时间**午睡**。§
20681§humanity§hjuːˈmænəti§The control of fire was the first and perhaps greatest of humanity's steps towards a life-enhancing technology.§**人类**在迈向提高生活质量的技术旅途中，对火的支配是第一步，可能也是最重要的一步。§
20682§intact§ɪnˈtækt§She hopes that her honor could remain intact.§她希望自己的名誉依旧能够**无损**。§
20683§stripe§straɪp§This skirt has a red stripe around the edge.§这条裙子的边上有一圈红色**条纹**。§
20684§mechanical§məˈkænɪkl§Practise that and don't stop until it becomes mechanical.§坚持练习，直到习惯成**自然**。§改例句：stop until 意思相反，应为 don't stop until
20685§junction§ˈdʒʌŋkʃn§The power station was built at the junction of two rivers.§那座发电站建于两河的**交汇处**。§
20686§detect§dɪˈtekt§The robots can detect unauthorised personnel and alert security staff immediately.§机器人能够**发现**未经允许擅自闯入的人员，并马上向保安人员发出警报。§
20687§detour§ˈdiːtʊə(r)§You can take a detour to get there and avoid Black Street.§你可以**绕道**去那，不走布莱克大街。§
20688§arthritis§ɑːˈθraɪtɪs§Rheumatoid arthritis belongs to the family of autoimmune diseases.§类风湿性**关节炎**属于自体免疫系统类疾病。§
20689§justice§ˈdʒʌstɪs§Where might is master, justice is servant.§有强权，就没有**正义**。§
20690§barrier§ˈbæriə(r)§The language barrier presents itself in stark form to firms who wish to market their products in other countries.§对于那些希望在其他国家销售自己产品的公司来说，语言成了明显的**障碍**。§
20691§replace§rɪˈpleɪs§The new fuel is as inefficient as the one they have replaced.§这种新型燃料和被它们**取代**的燃料一样效率低下。§
20692§diploma§dɪˈpləʊmə§Tim got a diploma at a private college.§蒂姆拿到了一所私立学院的**毕业证书**。§
20693§cosmic§ˈkɒzmɪk§The surface of Earth contains tons of cosmic dust.§地球表面有大量的**宇宙**尘埃。§
20694§extendable§ɪkˈstendəbl§The visa is for 15 days, extendable to one month.§此签证有效期为15天，**可延期**到一个月。§
20695§abundance§əˈbʌndəns§At the party, there was food and drink in abundance.§宴会上，食品和饮料供应**充足**。§
20696§supervisor§ˈsuːpəvaɪzə(r)§We have to put ourselves into the role of the manager or supervisor.§我们必须要融入经理或**主管**的角色。§
20697§jumble§ˈdʒʌmbl§Here is a jumble of books and newspaper.§这有一堆**杂乱的**书和报纸。§
20698§amaze§əˈmeɪz§We are amazed at the perfect symmetry of the building.§我们**惊诧**于这座建筑物完美的对称。§
20699§equip§ɪˈkwɪp§Underground offices in Japan are equipped with "virtual" windows and mirrors.§日本的地下办公室**装有**虚拟的窗户和镜子。§改例句：英文句中的中文引号改为英文引号
20700§permanent§ˈpɜːmənənt§Instead of moving from place to place, the family needed permanent dwellings.§这家人需要一个**长期的**居住地，而不是不断地搬家。§
20701§embed§ɪmˈbed§The traditional idea is deeply embedded in our university.§这个传统的想法在我们的大学里**根深蒂固**。§
20702§orientation§ˌɔːriənˈteɪʃn§Now that everyone knows what team they're in, we'll get on with the orientation programme.§既然每个人都明确了自己所在的小组，我们接着就开始进行**培训**项目。§
20703§deprive§dɪˈpraɪv§The accident deprived him of his feet.§这场意外事故使他**失去**了双脚。§
20704§dividend§ˈdɪvɪdend§We pay a dividend of 15 percent.§我们所付的**股息**为15%。§
20705§preference§ˈprefrəns§Many people expressed a strong preference for the original plan.§许多人强烈表示**喜欢**原先的计划。§
20706§contract§ˈkɒntrækt§Both sides should abide by the contract.§双方都应该遵守**合同**。§
20707§uneasy§ʌnˈiːzi§He was uneasy about the results of the final exams.§他为期末考试成绩**忧心忡忡**。§
20708§automatically§ˌɔːtəˈmætɪkli§Cars will be automatically controlled by computer in the future.§未来的汽车将由计算机**自动**控制。§
20709§female§ˈfiːmeɪl§A cow produces only one calf a year whereas a female ostrich can lay an egg every other day.§一头奶牛一年只能生一头小牛，而一只**雌**鸵鸟每隔一天就下一个蛋。§
20710§asset§ˈæset§Organizations should recognize that their employees are a significant part of their financial assets.§公司应该承认员工是其**财产**的重要组成部分。§
20711§athlete§ˈæθliːt§Professional athletes usually follow a strict diet and training plan to stay in top physical condition.§职业**运动员**通常会遵循严格的饮食和训练计划，以保持最佳的身体状态。§补例句
20712§clarity§ˈklærəti§This article was written with clarity.§这篇文章思路**清晰**。§
20713§swap§swɒp§Don't swap horses when crossing a stream.§危难之时不宜临阵**换**将。§改译文：「变动」没译出 swap（换），改为「临阵换将」
20714§sophisticated§səˈfɪstɪkeɪtɪd§Space management is now a highly sophisticated method of manipulating the way we shop to ensure maximum profit.§空间管理现在已成为一种非常**尖端**的技术，它通过控制我们的购物方式来实现利润最大化。§
20715§bulk§bʌlk§Ports take advantage of the need for breaking up bulk material.§港口充分利用了分解**大宗**原料的需求。§
20716§calibre§ˈkælɪbə(r)§They suggest that the calibre of these institutions be carefully examined.§他们建议要仔细调查这些机构的**资质**。§
20717§machinery§məˈʃiːnəri§The new mayor reformed the machinery of the government.§新市长对市政府**机构**进行了改革。§
20718§intimate§ˈɪntɪmət§The dance studio provides a smaller, more intimate space, which we use for ballet, modern dance and martial arts.§舞蹈室为我们练习芭蕾、现代舞和武术提供了一个更小、更**私密**的空间。§
20719§restrict§rɪˈstrɪkt§A student loan is not restricted to those who receive a maintenance grant in this school.§在这所学校，学生贷款并不**限于**那些领生活补助金的学生。§
20720§harsh§hɑːʃ§The report has harsh words for the countries that sold these weapons.§这篇报道**严厉**谴责了出售这些武器的国家。§
20721§parliament§ˈpɑːləmənt§The exhibition met with great opposition from Parliament.§这次展览遭到了**国会**的强烈反对。§
20722§remind§rɪˈmaɪnd§The notice reminds students that if they park a motor vehicle on university premises without a valid permit, they will be fined.§这个通知**提醒**学生们：未经允许就在校园里停放机动车会被罚款。§
